commitments.target: facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance
commitments.detail: These departments will review the operating plan before the director signs it.
The library will be open from 10:00 p.m. to midnight on weekdays.
Campus safety will be responsible for ensuring the safety of the library during late hours.
Library IT will provide necessary support to ensure the library's systems are operational during extended hours.
No additional budget allocation is required for this pilot as it does not exceed regular operating costs.
Ensure the library is operational from 10:00 p.m. to midnight on specified days.

Maintain IT services and systems during extended hours.
No additional budget allocated for overtime or other expenses.
